theorems.claim: After a future observation Q is realized and retained in addition to current evidence E, the compatible-world and identified sets under (E,Q) are subsets of those under E alone.
assumptions: Q is retained as an additional channel rather than replacing E
the realized pair (e,q) is compatible with at least one world
theorems.empirical_boundary: Whether the realized physical observation produces strict rather than weak contraction for the target estimand is empirical.

theorems.claim: A sequence of non-destructive retained augmentations produces a nested non-expanding chain of compatible-world and identified sets along the realized observation history.
assumptions: each new channel is retained in addition to the previous record
no intervening non-injective replacement discards prior evidence
theorems.empirical_boundary: Strict contraction at any particular step depends on the information carried by that step for the declared estimand.

theorems.claim: Under a coherent predictive joint law, conditional mutual information I(S;Q|E) equals the expected reduction in residual mechanism entropy and is nonnegative; it is positive exactly when expected entropy decreases strictly.
assumptions: S, Q and E admit the declared probability law
the entropies and conditional mutual information are well-defined
theorems.empirical_boundary: The predictive law and candidate-outcome model must be scientifically validated; positive expected gain does not imply equal pointwise shrinkage for every outcome.

theorems.claim: V3 refinement and realized MROD acquisition both act by refining the observational-equivalence partition characterized by Boundary; they differ in timing and selection rule rather than in post-realization compatible-set algebra.
assumptions: Boundary is defined by the equivalence relation induced by the retained observation map
V3 and realized MROD channels are added non-destructively
theorems.proof_type: operator composition over common equivalence partition
theorems.empirical_boundary: Rank, entropy and identified-set width are model-specific summaries and are not asserted to be numerically interchangeable.

theorems.claim: A deterministic information-losing transformation cannot be undone by deterministic downstream processing of the collapsed state alone, but an independently retained or newly acquired channel can restore a lost scientific distinction if the joint record separates the previously equivalent worlds.
assumptions: the loss transformation maps at least two scientifically distinct rich states to the same retained state
downstream repair without new information receives only that collapsed state
theorems.proof_type: function-composition impossibility plus constructive separating-channel condition
theorems.empirical_boundary: Availability, validity and strict informativeness of the independent/new channel are empirical.

not_claimed: strict physical refinement without empirical validation
equivalence of rank, entropy and identified-set width
natural biological causal identification from observation geometry alone
